'''Perekta Chasm''' was a rift in the [[Perekta Mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] that was formed during the numerous [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] that occurred during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Perekta Chasm appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
